seo.title: Ocean Eyes Coral Restoration School Program | Oceans Alive Foundation
seo.description: Six years, eighteen schools, one Marine Base: a schools programme pairing classroom lessons with hands on conservation and a student led environmental project.

PIPELINE.title: Classroom Lesson
PIPELINE.body: Learners are introduced to marine conservation, biodiversity and climate smart backyard kitchen gardening at their own school.

PIPELINE.title: Marine Base Practical
PIPELINE.body: The class travels to the Marine Base to connect classroom theory to real, hands on conservation work.

PIPELINE.title: Needs Assessment
PIPELINE.body: Oceans Alive and Ocean Eyes assess each school for environmental challenges and opportunities specific to that community.

PIPELINE.title: Student Led Project
PIPELINE.body: Learners design and run their own school based environmental project, moving from awareness into action.

hero.title: Ocean Eyes Coral Restoration School Program
hero.text: A six year partnership with Ocean Eyes, delivering marine conservation and climate smart backyard kitchen gardening education to school learners along the Kenyan coast.
hero.eyebrow2: With the Ministry of Education, community based organisations, and school patrons

impactStats.heading: A Consistent Platform for School Led Conservation
impactStats.text: Every school leaves with its own environmental project, addressing the specific challenges its own students identified.

callToAction.heading: Help Us Reach the Next School
callToAction.text: Your support helps extend marine conservation education, and its practical follow through, to more schools along the coast.
